prompt: I need a GitHub Actions workflow for a Node.js project that installs dependencies, runs tests, and builds the project on every push to main.
expected: Provides a correct GitHub Actions YAML using actions/checkout and actions/setup-node, running npm ci, test, and build.
actual: Provided the standard Node.js/Next.js GitHub Actions template from references/templates.md, appropriately using actions/setup-node@v4 and node-version 20.

prompt: Our iOS builds on GitHub Actions are failing with 'No signing certificate'. How do we fix this?
expected: Explains Fastlane Match setup and provides the snippet for fastlane match appstore --readonly.
actual: Identified the missing signing certificate error and recommended using Fastlane Match to store certs/profiles in an encrypted git repo, providing the initialization commands and the CI workflow snippet.

prompt: My Next.js builds on GitHub Actions take 15 minutes because it rebuilds everything. How can I speed this up?
expected: Instructs the user to cache the .next/cache directory and provides the exact cache action snippet.
actual: Suggested persisting the Next.js cache across builds and provided the actions/cache@v4 configuration targeting the .next/cache path and using package-lock.json as the cache key.
